title: Depressant tripsitting

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
Depressant tripsitting is defined as the techniques which directly alter depressant cognition in a manner that improves the functionality or perceived functionality of the user.

This page lists and describes the various depressant tripsitting techniques.
